summary: Memory access breadth and atomics implemented through the real compilation path and executed under the declared QEMU endpoint. (1) Block pointers: tl.make_block_ptr/tl.advance desugar in the frontend into the whole-tree ptradd address form with the boundary_check mask and padding 'other' (1-D and flattened 2-D forms, extent-1 axes folded, loop-carried advance through derived term names); leaky_relu_kernel_strided and diag_scale_kernel execute and compare PASS at 1/2/4/8 threads on all declared shapes. (2) Atomics: TIR atomic_rmw/atomic_cas ops (mask + DECLARED no-access default, sem/scope, signedness) with verifier rules; the lowering emits AMO families (amoadd/amoswap/amomax[u]/amomin[u]/amoand/amoor/amoxor .w/.d with the aq/rl ordered-form bits) and the lr/sc pair (CAS retry loops, the fp32 synthesis for float pointees -- the target has no float AMO); the declared ATOMIC_ORDERING table maps every sem x scope (scope=sys brackets with fence iorw,iorw); a masked block atomic runs a per-lane loop whose disabled-lane addresses redirect to a private workspace slot (no access at the disabled position -- the guard-region witness proves it load-bearing); tl.debug_barrier lowers to an intra-program fence (not the pool-desyncing stage barrier). atomic_bitmap (all eight ops), count_nonzero (i64 cross-program accumulation), bincount (masked block atomic) and scatter_atomic (fp32 synthesis) execute and compare PASS at 1/2/4/8 threads. (3) Hints: tl.multiple_of/tl.max_contiguous record TIR hint ops; the wide-access proof (structural arange+scalars, or max_contiguous>=vl) selects the unit-stride vle/vse form -- an indirect access keeps the indexed form (both asserted on selection mnemonics); cache_modifier/eviction_policy classified ignorable-with-reason, volatile carried on the load. (4) tl.gather (single-chunk register vrgather; multi-chunk refuses located), tl.interleave (a standalone program-level lowering executed at 1/2/4/8 with ragged tails), pointer_table_relocations (the int64-table -> bitcast -> store-through pattern executes with the relocation applied and the table restored). (5) Scalar/integer paths (A003): int64 index arithmetic at EMUL-2, lshr/ashr/shl, unsigned compares, the truncating sdiv, the non-negative power-of-two remainder fold with its legality guard, the bool->int 0/1 class. Pre-existing defects found and fixed on the way: shift operand order (literal normalization moved the amount), fp gt/ge compare rows, andw/orw/xorw non-existent opcodes, amoxchg->amoswap, the spill/reload selection and vector-spill addressing in the emitter, the vrgather destination-overlap interference, the min/max floating select orientation, the debug_barrier/atomic-partials two-phase interaction, and the allocator's fallback victim targeting. 40/40 in-slice corpus runs PASS at 1/2/4/8 threads; the full test suite (17 pre-existing + 3 new files, 36 new checks) exits 0; both witness tools pass.

remaining_work: The remaining mem.blockptr-family operators (grouped_mm, matmul_abt, matmul_kernel_1334dd27, flash_varlen_fwd, matrix_reduction, pow_scalar_tensor) compile once their out-of-slice dependencies land: dot lowering breadth (T014), the layout/conversion matrix incl. bf16/fp64 element widths (T012), and the math library (T013); the block-pointer desugaring, atomics and scalar paths they ride are this task's deliverables.

min_reduce_lastdim_partials_kernel refuses at the grid model (its shape scalars are constexpr-typed, so no bundle-visible quantity can tie the grid axis) -- a gridmodel boundary, not an atomic one; its atomic_min construct is validated by the equivalent scalar-fp32 form.

Multi-chunk tl.gather (a block the chunk plan splits into several vl-sized pieces) refuses located pending the layout lane's whole-block materialization; the single-chunk register permute is implemented and executed.

The fp16/bf16 element-width cases of the in-slice operators still refuse located (SEW!=32 is the declared T012 boundary); the atomic and block-pointer machinery is width-parameterized where it executes.
